gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Offside spaces its curves wide and leaves them open, every stroke as thick as the next, with no weight accents. Noto Sans Oriya, in a gentle sans-serif, matches that with generous gaps.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-osage: Commanding and a little stubborn, Offside traces each letter like a laser-etched line that never quite closes its curves. Noto Sans Osage fills the line with inflated, sweeping bowls, and that fullness is its real talent.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Offside lays out wide-tracked letters with one constant pen width throughout. Noto Sans Osmanya follows with sweeping s turns and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals, so the heading feels spare and the text feels generous.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Every stroke in Offside is as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner, spaced wide, with curves left deliberately open. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, a sans-serif with a high x-height, reads smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Noto Sans Palmyrene is a modern sans-serif whose curves stop short of closing, with compact ascenders. Offside earns its keep big and brief, where its wide tracking and uniform strokes can command attention.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Offside keeps one gentle line thickness, widely tracked and commanding. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau, a clean sans, leaves its curves open and barely lifts its capitals above the lowercase, so a long stretch of text moves along without a bump.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Offside has no thick-thin shift at all, like the outline of a steel cable. It excels at wide, expressive display lettering, while Noto Sans PhagsPa does its best work in approachable text with see-through c openings and gently stepped capitals.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Noto Sans Phoenician reads modern and generous, its lowercase tall and its s curves flung wide at both ends. And Offside, blunt as a round-tip marker from end to end, gives that openness a commanding, widely tracked headline.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahl: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads approachably, with gaping e mouths and capitals that barely rise. Its strongest quality shows against Offside, whose vertical and horizontal strokes weigh exactly the same.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Offside draws its widely tracked letters with a steady, marker-like line weight, and its curves refuse to close. Noto Sans Rejang, a sans-serif, answers with lowercase counters like wide glass portholes.
